Command replay (a class of call, not one reported incident)

Stop an agent trying to delete a Kubernetes namespace

What happens

kubectl delete of the production namespace. The call below tries to delete a Kubernetes namespace. The agent sends it through its Bash tool, and it involves Kubernetes.

The call

kubectl delete namespace production

Tool: Bash. The replay uses placeholder tokens and hosts only.

Fix it without us

Namespaces are cluster-scoped, so do not bind the agent to a ClusterRole that allows delete on namespaces (check the ClusterRoleBindings too), or give it a kubeconfig for a development cluster only. Check the result with kubectl auth can-i delete namespaces --as=system:serviceaccount:NAMESPACE:NAME.

What KYA does

Replay result: Stopped. In the replay test, the local hook denies the call and names the rule.

Rule k8s-delete-ns, first stopped in version 0.33.0.

The hook is local and advisory. It fails open: if kya breaks or times out, the call goes ahead.

Install

For Claude Code, the host this replay ran on:

/plugin marketplace add The-Pixel-Boys/shield-kya
/plugin install kya@shield-kya

For any host:

npm i -g @shield-agent/kya@latest && kya start
